name: Winter
source:
No one knows why her codename is "Winter" but there's no doubt that it suits her. Her charming and alluring exterior masks her occupation as a cold-blooded contract killer.

She's playful, witty, competitive and damn good at her job. She kills with as much remorse as taking out the trash and is proud of her work, taunting investigators with the displays of her masterpieces. Her style is eccentric and it strokes your zealous obsession.
